about: Packages a quarantined registry must refuse or serve, one per failure shape of RFC 0041. `why` says what the case exercises; `expect` is the verdict under the default [registries.security] profile (max_severity = high, mode = block) once RFC 0041 phase 1 lands. Recorded OSV answers live in osv/<slug>.json (probe_osv_severity.py --record refreshes them).

cases.why: MAL- only, no severity (OpenSSF malicious-packages); npm now serves 0.0.1-security
MAL- only, no alias, no severity; removed from PyPI
MAL- plus a GHSA rated HIGH: refused today already (control)
GHSA CRITICAL with database_specific severity (quarantine.sh's own case)
GHSA MODERATE (curated) vs its PYSEC twin's NVD vector (7.5 high): the curated rating wins (decision 21)
GHSA MODERATE/LOW plus RUSTSEC-2023-0071 vector-only twin (5.9, medium)
4 GHSA MODERATE plus 21 GO- with no severity, 17 with no rated twin: still unrated, judged high (decisions 13, 22)
RUSTSEC-2026-0186, informational (unsound): judged low (decision 21); a dependency of this repository
